items.reason: Eligibility requires only "DGM1 biomarker status (positive or negative) is available prior to randomization", and the short title says "With or Without the Novel Genomic Biomarker, DGM1". DGM1 is therefore not an entry or arm requirement, and the record states no mechanistic link to enzastaurin. The official title's "Who Possess the Novel Genomic Biomarker DGM1" contradicts this.

items.proposed: DGM1 not an eligibility/enrichment biomarker (stratification or exploratory_correlative), candidate_matched false
items.reason: Same item: positive or negative DGM1 status is allowed, no cohort is restricted to DGM1+, and there is no stated link to enzastaurin. Status must be known before randomisation, which suggests stratification, but the record does not say so.

items.coder_A: The enzastaurin arm is registered as ACTIVE_COMPARATOR (not EXPERIMENTAL), though the trial is a placebo-controlled test of enzastaurin added to TMZ/RT; strict reading of rule 1 could make it control_comparator.
items.reason: The official title is "Placebo-Controlled Phase 3 Study of Enzastaurin Added to Temozolomide", and the comparator is the PLACEBO_COMPARATOR arm. Enzastaurin is the only investigational agent, on a Stupp backbone (rule 4/C1). The ACTIVE_COMPARATOR label is a registry mislabel, and rule 1 (comparator arm only) does not apply.

items.coder_A: Official title targets patients 'Who Possess' DGM1 (suggesting enrichment/primary DGM1+ population) while eligibility admits positive or negative; record does not state whether DGM1 is a tumour marker or its mechanistic link to enzastaurin.
items.reason: The eligibility text, which admits "positive or negative", takes precedence over the title for entry requirements. The record does not say whether DGM1 is tumour or germline.

items.coder_B: Official title says patients who possess DGM1, but eligibility only requires DGM1 status (positive or negative) to be available and the short title says with or without DGM1; role may be stratification/exploratory, and its mechanistic link to enzastaurin is not stated.
items.reason: Same as Coder A's flag. Status is required to be known, not to be positive, and no mechanistic link is stated.

note: DGM1 is not selection: under D31-A3 the official title's "Who Possess the Novel Genomic Biomarker DGM1" does not count, and the eligibility requires only that "DGM1 biomarker status (positive or negative) is available prior to randomization" (no required value). So candidate_matched_selection stays false whatever the link. A6 pending XL: the DGM1 candidate_matched value (false) is kept as in the original; it cannot change the primary outcome because DGM1 is not an entry requirement. Enzastaurin in the ACTIVE_COMPARATOR-labelled arm is a candidate (D31-B14). The IDH-mutant exclusion is exempt (D31-A5). MGMT row set to exploratory_correlative (D31-A8). Whether DGM1 is a germline marker is not stated; it does not affect the outcome.
